177:t_1:249.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I will, if you can keep up with 《$$グローリー・スター$$》's methods.」

177:t_1:251.en:
$$セツコ$$
「It was the team I belonged to... And it is my pride.」

177:t_1:252.en:
$n
「Please, $$セツコ$$. I'll put my own pride on the line, too.」

177:t_1:253.en:
$$ランド$$
「Then let's start training right away! I can at least be your opponent in a mock battle.」

177:t_1:254.en:
$n
「I'm sorry after asking you myself, but I have something to do after this...」

177:t_1:256.en:
$n
「$$アルト$$'s been having nightmares lately. He's resting right now, too.」

177:t_1:257.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Now that you mention it, he isn't in the hangar...」

177:t_1:258.en:
$n
「I'll... go check on him. It's not like there's anything I can do, but...」

177:t_1:259.en:
$$セツコ$$
「All right, $n. Once that's settled, let's start training.」

177:t_1:260.en:
$n
「Thank you, $$セツコ$$. I'll be going, then.」

177:t_1:261.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...He really cares about his friends.」

177:t_1:262.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Yes... He lost his family, so his comrades in $c are irreplaceable to him.」

177:t_1:263.en:
$$スズネ$$
(But $$アルト$$... What on earth is going on with him...?)

177:t_1:266.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'm sorry. I startled you by speaking so suddenly.」

177:t_1:268.en:
$$セツコ$$
「You don't need to be nervous. I'm not after your $$スフィア$$.」

177:t_1:270.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Let me introduce myself properly. I'm $$セツコ・オハラ$$...」

177:t_1:271.en:
$$セツコ$$
「As you sensed, I'm the $$悲しみの乙女$$'s $$スフィア・リアクター$$.」

177:t_1:272.en:
$n
「I'm $F. It's a pleasure to meet you.」

177:t_1:273.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...I heard about $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. I'm sorry for your loss.」

177:t_1:274.en:
$n
「You knew $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ too, $$セツコ$$.」

177:t_1:275.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Yes... I fought alongside him on $$翠の地球$$.」

177:t_1:276.en:
$$セツコ$$
(He said... the $$いがみ合う双子$$' $$リアクター$$ would save us...)

177:t_1:277.en:
$$セツコ$$
(I don't know what he meant... But I... want to believe him...)

177:t_1:279.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...May I call you $n, like everyone else?」

177:t_1:281.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Don't be so nervous. I'm a little older, but there's not that much difference between our ages.」

177:t_1:283.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You're a boy after all, $n. You get like this the moment you see someone pretty.」

177:t_1:285.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You can't hide it. I've thought for a while that you have a weakness for older women, $n.」

177:t_1:287.en:
$$スズネ$$
(Though I'm older than him, too...)

177:t_1:288.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Hehe... I thought he'd be more sensitive, but he's surprisingly ordinary.」

177:t_1:289.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Not quite. He seems like an ordinary high school boy now, but until recently, he was like a bare knife...」

177:t_1:290.en:
$$スズネ$$
「He thought adults didn't understand anything, and he hurt everyone who came near him.」

177:t_1:293.en:
$$スズネ$$
「But meeting everyone in $c changed him before our eyes. That frail little boy has now become a full-fledged...」

177:t_1:294.en:
$n
「W-wait a minute, Miss $$スズネ$$! What have you got against me!?」

177:t_1:295.en:
$$スズネ$$
「This is your punishment for earlier.」

177:t_1:297.en:
$$スズネ$$
「If you think I'll tell you everything like that, you're very wrong. Think for yourself a little.」

177:t_1:298.en:
$n
(I think... I pushed the wrong button...)

177:t_1:299.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Hehe... Miss $$スズネ$$ really is a teacher.」

177:t_1:302.en:
$n
「I... have something I'd like you to teach me, too, $$セツコ$$.」

177:t_1:304.en:
$n
「$$シン$$ tells me you were in the Federation's combat tactics research team, $$セツコ$$.」

177:t_1:305.en:
$n
「Please. I'd like you to coach me in piloting.」

177:t_1:306.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...Judging by the last battle, I thought you fought well enough already...」

177:t_1:307.en:
$n
「Well enough isn't enough. I... want to get stronger.」

177:t_1:308.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Improving your skills beyond this point will be harder than you imagine.」

177:t_1:310.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Um... $$セツコ$$... Does $n still have room to improve?」

177:t_1:311.en:
$$セツコ$$
「From what I can see, $n sometimes lets his machine's performance get the better of him.」

177:t_1:312.en:
$$セツコ$$
「For example, when $n wants to stop at a particular point, he shoots past it at high speed, then forces a correction with reverse thrust, or...」

177:t_1:313.en:
$$セツコ$$
「He slows down more than necessary, then adjusts at the last moment.」

177:t_1:314.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I know what you mean! When I first became his partner, I often got motion sickness!」

177:t_1:315.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'm not as strong as Captain $$アムロ$$, but I have some confidence in my precise piloting.」

177:t_1:316.en:
$$セツコ$$
「My superior trained me rigorously in that.」

177:t_1:318.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I will, if you can keep up with 《$$グローリー・スター$$》's methods.」

177:t_1:320.en:
$$セツコ$$
「It was the team I belonged to... And it is my pride.」

177:t_1:321.en:
$n
「Please, $$セツコ$$. I'll put my own pride on the line, too.」

177:t_1:322.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Then I'll go greet some old acquaintances. Let's discuss your training afterward.」

177:t_1:323.en:
$n
「...$$セツコ・オハラ$$ of $$グローリー・スター$$, huh...」

177:t_1:326.en:
$$宗介$$
「We landed in a sea by that name on $$翠の地球$$.」

177:t_1:327.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Let's be precise. $$サイデリアル$$ attacked us during atmospheric entry and knocked us way off course.」

177:t_1:328.en:
$$シン$$
「Still, I never expected to find you there, $$ガロード$$.」
